 - Blog - 02 July 2026 Working in transport and logistics without a diploma: what are your chances? 
Do you think that without a diploma you have little chance in transport and logistics? Then you are wrong. On the contrary - right now there are plenty of opportunities for enthusiastic people who want to work. In this sector it's not only about "papers", but above all about commitment and motivation. And there is a huge demand for exactly that. werken in transport zonder diploma Can you work in the transport and logistics sector without a diploma? 
Yes, you can easily work in transport and logistics without a diploma. In both areas there are plenty of positions where you mainly learn by doing. In logistics, you can start in a warehouse as an order picker or logistics employee. In transport, you can work as a driver's assistant, mover, loader, or later grow into a truck driver role. Clients often look not only at your education, but above all at your motivation, commitment and work attitude. 
In the transport and logistics sector, you can quickly enter the job market and develop step by step. Especially through employment agencies, there are often opportunities to start immediately, gain practical experience, and possibly later obtain certificates, driving licenses or training. 
What matters is: - you are motivated and reliable - you are able to do physical work - you want to learn and continue developing 
With this solid foundation, you can go a long way. What logistics and transport jobs can you do without a diploma? 
There are many logistics jobs without a diploma where you can start immediately. These are the most common positions: 
Logistics employee
